items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Fine trombone player. Fine, but I forgot about him. Fine, fine player.

ctx.x: He was a master, dear, above us all. He was a master, huh? Yeah, I'm a master. Yeah, but the fella Tucker, when I tell him about it, I live way back in the... No, you don't know him. I just know him by name, see him play, and I didn't know him. But he was a good, too.
Fine trombone player. Fine, but I forgot about him. Fine, fine player.
